## What happened?
Describe the expected and actual behavior.

## Environment
mcp_worker commit/version, OS, Docker/Node/Worker version, storage state
and local or remote deployment. Use placeholders for private hostnames.

## Reproduction
Minimal steps using a disposable environment.

## Evidence
Redacted error code, relevant log excerpt and test results. Never include
tokens, passwords, private keys, env files or production data.

For suspected security vulnerabilities, use the private reporting guidance
in SECURITY.md rather than this template.
